paragraphs: Creditspring’s mission to boost financial stability through subscription products mirrors my recent work building predictive models that directly influence product decisions. I crafted scikit‑learn pipelines and LSTM/BiRNN/CNN models in TensorFlow/Keras, deploying them as FastAPI services in Docker to enable rapid, reliable scoring for user‑centric features.

I proposed and prototyped an MCP‑based agentic tool in Python, using FastMCP, Ollama gpt‑oss:20b, PostgreSQL and GitHub Actions CI, for a Madrid‑based product start‑up client. The prototype was showcased in a live stakeholder demo, demonstrating clear value and technical feasibility.
